did: Home now keeps where each Studio take stands on the conveyor (in the oven, cooking, ready for pickup, picked up, canned) as moves it never rewrites, with the take's history, and the phone can move a take and list a station. Moves are ordered by their number, never by the phone's clock: a review showed that a guard trusting the clock could wedge a take for good, so the coordinator chose ordering by number. A take you let go or that an idea's answer names is off the conveyor. Deleting a take in My data takes its moves with it, and the receipt says so.

calls.title: How a take's moves are ordered
options: by move number: a move names the newest it saw, and a stale one is refused
by the phone's clock on the move
calls.why: A phone's clock can be wrong by years, and a clock-ordered guard let one bad move wedge a take for good; the number is held by home (coordinator, under the owner's standing 'go with the recommended').
calls.undo: Change the move rule in voice_repo::conveyor and the station route's 409.

calls.title: Which takes are on the conveyor
options: Studio takes only, not idea answers or takes let go
calls.why: An idea's answer belongs to its idea, and a take let go is set aside; listing them would offer moves that make no sense.
